label: Actual esse is received per se with uniform loss and a common bound
paraphrase: Open bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed: the actual concreta at w are countable and carry real quantities such that every actual concretum has a positive amount of esse at most a common bound M; its esse is at most its own esse plus the weighted esse of the things it receives from, with nonnegative summable weights whose total for each receiver is at most a fixed q < 1; it receives with positive weight only from its actual concrete grounds; and only an actual concretum with no actual concrete ground has positive own esse. The quantities carry no real-world calibration.
